column1: # Official Yarn release checksums, one row per release:
# A row means the committed `.yarn/releases/yarn-<version>.cjs` (or `.js`) is
# @yarnpkg/cli-dist@<version> tarball. scanner.sh hashes each committed release
# and looks the digest up here: a match is informational, anything else fails the
# scripts/update-yarn-releases.sh fills this file from the npm registry.
# Lines beginning with # are comments; blank lines are ignored.
